entry.summary:
Introduction
Electricity costs are usually the biggest part of operating an ASIC mining setup, often making up over 70% of expenses. To maximize return on investment (ROI), optimizing power consumption without sacrificing too much hashing power is essential. Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) offers a potent technique for tuning ASIC miner performance dynamically based on workload, ambient temperature, and energy cost. In this article, we'll explain why DVFS matters in ASIC mining, how it works, and practical strategies for miners and developers to implement it alongside hosting platforms for smarter, more energy-efficient operations. This weekend, Andrej Karpathy, the former director of AI at Tesla and a founding member of OpenAI, decided he wanted to read a book. But he did not want to read it alone. He wanted to read it accompanied by a committee of artificial intelligences, each offering its own perspective, critiquing the others, and eventually synthesizing a final answer under the guidance of a "Chairman." To make this happen, Karpathy wrote what he called a "vibe code project" — a piece of software written quickly, largely by AI assistants, intended for fun rather than function. He posted the result, a repository called "LLM Council," to GitHub with a stark disclaimer: "I’m not going to support it in any way... Code is ephemeral now and libraries are over."

entry.title: Black Forest Labs launches Flux.2 AI image models to challenge Nano Banana Pro and Midjourney
entry.summary: It's not just Google's Gemini 3, Nano Banana Pro, and Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.5 we have to be thankful for this year around the Thanksgiving holiday here in the U.S. No, today the German AI startup Black Forest Labs released FLUX.2, a new image generation and editing system complete with four different models designed to support production-grade creative workflows. FLUX.2 introduces multi-reference conditioning, higher-fidelity outputs, and improved text rendering, and it expands the company’s open-core ecosystem with both commercial endpoints and open-weight checkpoints.
